name: get_purchase_quote
description: Get a read-only domain registration quote for the selected team. Checks availability and pricing and returns payment-method, tax/fee, registration, and auto-renew disclosures, plus a signed quote token valid for five minutes. Requesting a quote does not authorize a purchase, enable auto-renew, register, reserve, or charge for a domain. Digital subscriptions, credits, and add-ons cannot be quoted or purchased through this tool.

autoRenew.description: Whether to auto-renew at term end. Defaults to true. Not part of the signed quote token.

product.description: Only domain registration quotes are available.

teamId.description:
The ID or slug of the team that owns the resource.
Team IDs start with "team_".
If you do not know the team ID or slug, it can be found through these mechanism:
- Read the file .vercel/project.json if it exists and extract the orgId
- Use the `list_teams` tool

years.description: Registration term in years. Defaults to the TLD minimum.
